items.title: Uber’s New Kenyan Safari Business Is Already Stumbling
items.summary: NAIROBI—  Uber’s  new Kenyan safari business is stumbling as local guides push back against the idea of the ride-hailing giant muscling into a trade they have practiced for decades.  The San Francisco-based company touted Uber Safari as a service that would make booking a lion-sighting in Nairobi National Park as easy as ordering a ride to the city’s airport.  “It got to a point where safety was paramount,” said Uber East Africa General Manager  Imran Manji,  who helped create the service.
